description.en: Verify that a citation exists and that its metadata is right for DeepSeek Harness: DOI/PMID/arXiv/BibTeX resolution through Crossref, PubMed and arXiv, field-by-field metadata comparison, and a REP v1 evidence record.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 核对引文是否存在、元数据是否正确：经 Crossref/PubMed/arXiv 解析 DOI/PMID/arXiv/BibTeX，逐字段比较元数据，并生成 REP v1 证据记录。
